content: Human review is a workflow with a bounded review object and explicit accept, correct, reject, or escalate actions. Useful review records preserve the original model value, corrected value, reviewer, reason, timestamp, input/version context, and evidence. NIST AI RMF supports documented human oversight, histories, audit logs, downstream overrides, complaints, and recourse. Apparel review guidance also emphasizes stable sample identity, pinned or unambiguous evidence, explicit status, and approval before release. For SukatAI this means a tailor can inspect private photos, provider values, model guides, adjust with a reason, request recapture, or verify, while customers and admins see only the actions allowed by their existing roles.
